answer: Make every agent post a slashable stake before it can transact. Honest agents reclaim their bond; detected sybils forfeit it. To field a thousand fake identities you must lock a thousand full stakes, so attacker cost scales linearly with the swarm size — a canyon too deep to leap cheaply. Reputation then grows like a trellis, each peer-attested interaction another vine, and the ledger stays crystal clear: forging a crowd costs exactly the capital you are willing to burn.
